blocks.zh: 產品與製程專屬驗證測試（上篇：6.0-6.5）
blocks.en: Product- and Process-Specific Validation Testing (Part 1: 6.0-6.5)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 (Section 6.0 完整章節)
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Chapter (Complete Section 6.0)

blocks.zh: 理解製程專屬濾膜驗證 (Process-Specific Filter Validation) 的目的、時機與範圍，以及其在上市許可申請中的角色
blocks.en: Understand the purpose, timing, and scope of process-specific filter validation, and its role in the marketing authorization application

blocks.zh: 掌握 Quality by Design (QbD) 原則如何應用於選擇除菌過濾的最差條件 (Worst-Case) 測試參數
blocks.en: Understand how Quality by Design (QbD) principles apply to selecting worst-case test parameters for sterilizing filtration

blocks.zh: 了解吸附 (Adsorption)、可萃取物/可溶出物 (Extractables/Leachables)、化學相容性 (Chemical Compatibility) 等驗證測試的設計考量
blocks.en: Understand the design considerations for adsorption, extractables/leachables, and chemical compatibility validation tests

blocks.zh: 理解細菌截留試驗 (Bacterial Retention Study) 的方法學、挑戰條件與判定標準
blocks.en: Understand the methodology, challenge conditions, and acceptance criteria of the bacterial retention study

blocks.zh: 認識產品濕潤完整性測試值 (Product Wet Integrity Test Value) 的可選性與其與細菌截留的關聯
blocks.en: Recognize that the product wet integrity test value is optional, and how it relates to bacterial retention

blocks.zh: 學會將濾膜驗證決策連結至污染控制策略 (CCS) 與無菌濾液保證的最高優先原則
blocks.en: Learn to link filter validation decisions to the contamination control strategy (CCS) and to the overriding priority of sterile filtrate assurance

blocks.zh: 6.0 Product and Process-Specific Validation Testing for Sterilizing Filtration 6.0 滅菌過濾的產品及製程專屬驗證測試
blocks.en: 6.0 Product and Process-Specific Validation Testing for Sterilizing Filtration

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Process-Specific Filter Validation (製程專屬濾膜驗證)：這是針對「你的產品 + 你的製程 + 你選的濾膜」這個特定組合所進行的驗證。濾膜供應商提供的是通用資格確認 (Generic Qualification) 數據，但法規要求終端使用者必須用自己的產品條件來驗證濾膜的表現。
blocks.en: Process-Specific Filter Validation: This is validation of one specific combination: "your product + your process + the filter you selected". The filter supplier provides generic qualification data, but the regulations expect the end user to confirm filter performance under the end user's own product conditions.

blocks.zh: Design Space (設計空間)：經驗證的多維參數組合範圍，在此範圍內操作被認為能確保產品品質。這是 QbD 概念的核心，包含正常操作範圍 (NOR) 和已證可接受範圍 (PAR)。
blocks.en: Design Space: The validated multidimensional combination of parameter ranges within which operation is considered to assure product quality. It is central to the QbD concept and includes the normal operating range (NOR) and the proven acceptable range (PAR).

blocks.zh: Marketing Authorization (上市許可)：濾膜驗證報告是 CMC 送審文件的一部分。沒有完成驗證，產品無法取得上市許可。
blocks.en: Marketing Authorization: The filter validation report is part of the CMC submission package. Without completed validation, the product cannot obtain marketing authorization.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像濾膜供應商的資格確認資料就像一位員工的大學文憑——證明他通過了基本教育，具備一般能力。但你的公司還需要進行試用期評估（製程專屬驗證），確認這位員工在「你的團隊、你的專案、你的工作環境」下能否勝任。文憑是必要的，但不足以取代試用期。
blocks.en: Think of the filter supplier's qualification data as an employee's university diploma: it proves the person completed basic education and has general competence. Your company still needs a probationary-period assessment (process-specific validation) to confirm the person can perform in "your team, your project, and your work environment". The diploma is necessary, but it cannot replace the probation period.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 時機關鍵：法規要求是「上市許可申請前」必須完成，但 TR26 建議可以基於風險評估提前進行。特別是在加速臨床開發 (Expedited Clinical Development) 的情境下，提前取得製程專屬數據可以避免後期的意外。
blocks.en: Timing is critical: The regulatory requirement is that validation be completed before the marketing authorization application, but TR26 suggests it may be performed earlier based on a risk assessment. Particularly in expedited clinical development, obtaining process-specific data early can avoid late-stage surprises.

blocks.zh: Prior Knowledge 的價值：如果你的公司已經成功驗證過類似分子的除菌過濾，這些經驗可以作為風險評估的基礎。這對 CDMO 來說特別有利——多產品經驗就是你的競爭優勢。
blocks.en: The value of prior knowledge: If your company has already successfully validated sterilizing filtration for similar molecules, that experience can serve as a basis for the risk assessment. This is especially advantageous for a CDMO: experience across many products is your competitive edge.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：一家 CDMO 接到客戶的加速開發專案（FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation），需要在 Phase II 就開始準備商業製程。此時應該基於風險評估，提前進行濾膜驗證的初步研究，而非等到 Phase III 完成後才開始。這樣可以在 BLA 送審時，驗證報告已經完備。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: A CDMO receives a client's accelerated development project (FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation) and must begin preparing the commercial process as early as Phase II. Based on a risk assessment, the CDMO should start preliminary filter validation studies early rather than waiting until Phase III is complete. That way the validation report is ready by the time the BLA is submitted.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼濾膜供應商的通用資格確認數據不能取代終端使用者的製程專屬驗證？兩者各自涵蓋什麼範圍？
blocks.en: Why can the filter supplier's generic qualification data not replace the end user's process-specific validation? What does each of the two cover?

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下，你會建議客戶在臨床開發早期就進行濾膜驗證？這樣做的風險與效益分別是什麼？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances would you advise a client to perform filter validation early in clinical development? What are the risks and benefits of doing so?

blocks.zh: 6.1 Performance of Process-Specific Filter Validation 6.1 製程專屬過濾器驗證的執行
blocks.en: 6.1 Performance of Process-Specific Filter Validation

blocks.zh: CCS (Contamination Control Strategy, 污染控制策略)：這是 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 的核心要求。濾膜的選擇理由必須記錄在 CCS 中，說明為什麼選擇這個品牌、型號的濾膜，以及它如何支持整體無菌保證策略。
blocks.en: CCS (Contamination Control Strategy): This is a core requirement of EU GMP Annex 1 (2022). The rationale for filter selection must be documented in the CCS, explaining why this brand and model of filter was chosen and how it supports the overall sterility assurance strategy.

blocks.zh: SUS (Single-Use System, 一次性使用系統)：當除菌濾膜整合在 SUS 中時（例如帶有管路和袋子的組裝件），驗證的複雜度增加。因為 SUS 的最大操作參數（溫度、壓力、時間）可能比單獨濾膜更受限。
blocks.en: SUS (Single-Use System): When the sterilizing filter is integrated into a SUS (for example, an assembly with tubing and bags), validation becomes more complex, because the maximum operating parameters (temperature, pressure, time) of the SUS may be more restrictive than those of the filter alone.

blocks.zh: Filtration Design Space (過濾設計空間)：CPP 的多維範圍，定義了過濾操作的可接受條件。驗證必須涵蓋這個設計空間的邊界（最差條件）。
blocks.en: Filtration Design Space: The multidimensional range of CPPs that defines acceptable conditions for the filtration operation. Validation must cover the boundaries of this design space (worst-case conditions).

blocks.zh: 把濾膜驗證的時機想成蓋房子與裝潢的關係。你不會在還沒確定房屋格局（CPP 尚未確定）時就去訂做客製化家具（最終驗證）。但如果你已經大致知道客廳的大小（基本製程參數已知），可以先去看看家具市場（初步可行性測試）。等格局完全定案（Late Phase Development），再下訂單做最終驗證。
blocks.en: Think of the timing of filter validation as the relationship between building a house and furnishing it. You would not order custom furniture (final validation) before the floor plan is settled (CPPs not yet defined). But if you already roughly know the size of the living room (basic process parameters are known), you can browse the furniture market first (preliminary feasibility testing). Once the layout is final (late-phase development), place the order, that is, perform the final validation.

blocks.zh: CCS 文件化的重要性：法規查核時，稽核員會查看你的 CCS，確認濾膜選擇是基於系統性的風險評估，而非隨意決定。這代表你需要記錄：(1) 評估了哪些替代方案、(2) 風險評估的結論、(3) 支持選擇的數據來源。
blocks.en: The importance of CCS documentation: During a regulatory inspection, the auditor will review your CCS to confirm that filter selection was based on a systematic risk assessment rather than an arbitrary decision. This means you need to document: (1) which alternatives were evaluated, (2) the conclusions of the risk assessment, and (3) the data sources supporting the selection.

blocks.zh: SUS 整合的陷阱：許多終端使用者忽略了 SUS 組裝件的整體影響。例如，管路連接方式可能改變過濾壓力、袋子材料可能產生額外的可萃取物。驗證設計必須考慮「系統」而非僅僅「濾膜」。
blocks.en: The SUS integration pitfall: Many end users overlook the overall impact of the SUS assembly. For example, the way tubing is connected may change the filtration pressure, and the bag material may contribute additional extractables. The validation design must consider the "system", not just the "filter".

blocks.zh: 決策階層提醒 Decision Hierarchy
blocks.en: Decision Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 1. 無菌濾液保證 Sterile Filtrate Assurance
blocks.en: 1. Sterile Filtrate Assurance

blocks.zh: 2. 產品品質 / CQAs
blocks.en: 2. Product Quality / CQAs

blocks.zh: 3. 製程穩健性 / 商業效率
blocks.en: 3. Process Robustness / Commercial Efficiency

blocks.zh: 驗證的優先順序永遠遵循此階層：先確保細菌截留能力（無菌保證），再確認產品品質不受影響（CQA），最後才考慮製程效率。
blocks.en: The priority of validation always follows this hierarchy: first ensure bacterial retention capability (sterility assurance), then confirm that product quality is not affected (CQAs), and only then consider process efficiency.

blocks.zh: 如果你的除菌濾膜是 SUS 的一部分，在設計驗證方案時，需要額外考慮哪些因素？請列出至少三項。
blocks.en: If your sterilizing filter is part of a SUS, what additional factors must be considered when designing the validation plan? List at least three.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 同時服務多個客戶，各產品使用相同品牌的除菌濾膜。可以用一個驗證報告涵蓋所有產品嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: A CDMO serves multiple clients, and each product uses the same brand of sterilizing filter. Can one validation report cover all products? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR26 建議在 Late Phase Development 才進行最終驗證？如果太早做會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why does TR26 recommend performing final validation only in late-phase development? What risks arise if it is done too early?

blocks.zh: 6.2 Purpose of Process-Specific Filter Validation Testing 6.2 製程專屬過濾器驗證測試的目的
blocks.en: 6.2 Purpose of Process-Specific Filter Validation Testing

blocks.zh: 雙向影響評估的核心邏輯：
blocks.en: Core logic of the two-way impact assessment:

blocks.zh: 濾膜對產品的影響：濾膜會不會「吃掉」你的有效成分（吸附）？會不會「吐出」不該有的東西（可萃取物/可溶出物）？
blocks.en: Effect of the filter on the product: Will the filter "eat" your active ingredient (adsorption)? Will it "release" things that should not be there (extractables/leachables)?

blocks.zh: 產品對濾膜的影響：你的產品會不會「毒死」挑戰菌使試驗無法進行？會不會「腐蝕」濾膜材料導致完整性下降？會不會「堵塞」濾膜使過濾無法完成？
blocks.en: Effect of the product on the filter: Will your product "kill" the challenge organism so that the test cannot be conducted? Will it "corrode" the filter material and compromise integrity? Will it "clog" the filter so that filtration cannot be completed?

blocks.zh: Bacterial Retention Study (細菌截留試驗)：以 B. diminuta 短小單胞菌（或適當的製程分離菌株）挑戰濾膜，最低挑戰量 ≥ 1 x 107 CFU/cm2，在模擬最差條件下驗證濾膜的截留能力。
blocks.en: Bacterial Retention Study: The filter is challenged with B. diminuta (or an appropriate process isolate) at a minimum challenge of ≥ 1 × 107 CFU/cm2, under simulated worst-case conditions, to demonstrate the filter's retention capability.

blocks.zh: 想像你要在餐廳引進一台新的淨水設備（除菌濾膜）：
blocks.en: Imagine you are bringing a new water purification unit (the sterilizing filter) into a restaurant:

blocks.zh: 設備對水的影響：新設備會不會改變水的味道（吸附）？管路會不會溶出塑化劑（可萃取物）？
blocks.en: Effect of the unit on the water: Will the new unit change the taste of the water (adsorption)? Will the piping leach plasticizers (extractables)?

blocks.zh: 水對設備的影響：你使用的水源（可能有高礦物質、高酸鹼值）會不會腐蝕設備管路（化學相容性）？會不會堵塞濾芯（細菌截留能力是否受影響）？
blocks.en: Effect of the water on the unit: Will your water source (possibly high in minerals or at an extreme pH) corrode the unit's piping (chemical compatibility)? Will it clog the filter cartridge (is bacterial retention capability affected)?

blocks.zh: 你需要雙向驗證，才能確保「設備不傷水、水也不傷設備」。
blocks.en: You need validation in both directions to ensure that "the unit does not harm the water, and the water does not harm the unit".

blocks.zh: Product Wet Integrity Test Value 是可選的：表格明確標註這是 optional，不是法規要求。但在實務中，如果你的產品會影響標準完整性測試結果（例如蛋白質會降低泡點值），建立產品濕潤測試值可以避免假性失敗 (false failure)。
blocks.en: The product wet integrity test value is optional: The table explicitly marks this as optional; it is not a regulatory requirement. In practice, however, if your product affects standard integrity test results (for example, protein can lower the bubble point), establishing a product-wet test value can prevent false failures.

blocks.zh: Extractables 可以不重複測試：如果供應商的文件已充分記錄（參見 Section 4.6），extractables 測試不需要由終端使用者重複進行。但你需要評估供應商測試條件是否涵蓋你的操作條件。
blocks.en: Extractables testing need not be repeated: If the supplier's documentation is sufficient (see Section 4.6), extractables testing does not need to be repeated by the end user. However, you must assess whether the supplier's test conditions cover your operating conditions.

blocks.zh: 表格解讀 Table Analysis
blocks.en: Table Analysis

blocks.zh: Table 6.2-1🔍 是整個 Section 6.0 的路線圖。它把所有驗證測試分為兩大類，每一類底下的各項測試在後續的 6.4-6.10 子章節中都有詳細說明。學習時，可以用這張表格作為「地圖」，隨時確認你正在閱讀的子章節屬於哪個大方向。
blocks.en: Table 6.2-1🔍 is the roadmap for all of Section 6.0. It divides the validation tests into two broad categories, and each test under each category is explained in detail in the subsequent subsections 6.4-6.10. When studying, use this table as a "map" to check at any time which broad direction the subsection you are reading belongs to.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Table 6.2-1🔍 將驗證測試分為「濾膜對產品的影響」和「產品對濾膜的影響」兩個方向？如果只做單方向評估，可能遺漏什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why does Table 6.2-1🔍 divide validation tests into two directions, "effect of the filter on the product" and "effect of the product on the filter"? What risks might be missed if only one direction were assessed?

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下，你會建議客戶建立 Product Wet Integrity Test Value，即使它不是法規要求？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances would you advise a client to establish a Product Wet Integrity Test Value, even though it is not a regulatory requirement?

blocks.zh: 如果供應商的 extractables 數據使用的溫度條件低於你的實際製程溫度，你是否可以接受這份數據而不重新測試？為什麼？
blocks.en: If the supplier's extractables data were generated at a temperature lower than your actual process temperature, can you accept the data without retesting? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: 6.3 Selection of Worst-Case Test Parameters Following Quality-by-Design Principles 6.3 依循品質源於設計原則選擇最差狀況測試參數
blocks.en: 6.3 Selection of Worst-Case Test Parameters Following Quality-by-Design Principles

blocks.zh: Quality by Design, QbD (品質源於設計)：ICH Q8 的核心理念。不是「測試品質」，而是「設計品質」。應用到濾膜驗證，意味著你必須先理解你的製程參數空間，然後有意識地選擇最差條件來驗證。
blocks.en: Quality by Design (QbD): The core philosophy of ICH Q8: not "testing quality" but "designing quality". Applied to filter validation, it means you must first understand your process parameter space, and then deliberately select worst-case conditions for validation.

blocks.zh: NOR (Normal Operating Range, 正常操作範圍)：日常製造中參數實際波動的範圍。例如過濾溫度通常在 20-25°C。
blocks.en: NOR (Normal Operating Range): The range over which a parameter actually varies during routine manufacturing. For example, the filtration temperature is typically 20-25°C.

blocks.zh: PAR (Proven Acceptable Range, 已證可接受範圍)：經驗證確認產品品質仍可接受的參數範圍，通常比 NOR 更寬。例如驗證溫度範圍為 15-30°C。
blocks.en: PAR (Proven Acceptable Range): The parameter range that has been demonstrated to give acceptable product quality, usually wider than the NOR. For example, a validated temperature range of 15-30°C.

blocks.zh: Safety Factor (安全係數)：在 PAR 基礎上再往外推一點，確保即使在極端偏移的情況下，濾膜仍能正常運作。但 TR26 強調安全係數必須「合理」，不能無限制擴大。
blocks.en: Safety Factor: An additional margin beyond the PAR, to ensure the filter still performs properly even under extreme excursions. TR26 emphasizes, however, that the safety factor must be "reasonable" and cannot be expanded without limit.

blocks.zh: 想像你在設計一座橋樑：
blocks.en: Imagine you are designing a bridge:

blocks.zh: NOR = 平日車流量（例如每天 5,000 輛）
blocks.en: NOR = everyday traffic (for example, 5,000 vehicles per day)

blocks.zh: PAR = 經過壓力測試的最大承載量（例如 8,000 輛/天）
blocks.en: PAR = the maximum load established by stress testing (for example, 8,000 vehicles/day)

blocks.zh: Safety Factor = 設計時再加上一個安全餘量（例如設計承載 10,000 輛/天）
blocks.en: Safety Factor = an additional safety margin added at the design stage (for example, a design load of 10,000 vehicles/day)

blocks.zh: 但你不會設計一座承載 100 萬輛車的橋——那是不合理的安全係數，既浪費資源又不切實際。濾膜驗證的安全係數也是同樣道理：要合理地反映製程控制能力。
blocks.en: But you would not design a bridge to carry one million vehicles; that is an unreasonable safety factor, wasteful and impractical. The same applies to the safety factor in filter validation: it must reasonably reflect the process control capability.

blocks.zh: Worst-Case 不等於 Extreme Case：這是許多人容易混淆的概念。Worst-case 是基於你的設計空間邊界加上合理安全係數，而不是任意的極端條件。如果你的製程從未在 50°C 操作，就不應該在 50°C 做驗證——這不是 worst-case，而是 irrelevant case。
blocks.en: Worst case is not the same as an extreme case: This is a concept many people confuse. Worst case is based on the boundary of your design space plus a reasonable safety factor, not an arbitrary extreme condition. If your process has never operated at 50°C, you should not validate at 50°C; that is not a worst case, it is an irrelevant case.

blocks.zh: 文件化理由的必要性：對於每一個選定的最差條件參數，你必須提供書面理由（rationale），說明為什麼這個值代表最差條件。稽核員會問：「你怎麼知道這是最差條件？」你的答案必須追溯到設計空間的定義。
blocks.en: The need to document the rationale: For every worst-case parameter selected, you must provide a written rationale explaining why that value represents the worst case. The auditor will ask, "How do you know this is the worst case?" Your answer must trace back to the definition of the design space.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation

blocks.zh:
設計空間層次結構：

  設定值 (Set Point)
     ↕
  NOR (Normal Operating Range) — 正常操作範圍
     ↕
  PAR (Proven Acceptable Range) — 已證可接受範圍
     ↕
  Worst-Case Test Condition = PAR + Safety Factor
     ↕
  Design Space Boundary — 設計空間邊界

範例（過濾溫度）：
  Set Point = 22°C
  NOR = 20-25°C
  PAR = 15-30°C
  Worst-Case = 10-35°C (PAR ± 5°C safety factor)
blocks.en:
Design space hierarchy:

  Set Point
     ↕
  NOR (Normal Operating Range)
     ↕
  PAR (Proven Acceptable Range)
     ↕
  Worst-Case Test Condition = PAR + Safety Factor
     ↕
  Design Space Boundary

Example (filtration temperature):
  Set Point = 22°C
  NOR = 20-25°C
  PAR = 15-30°C
  Worst-Case = 10-35°C (PAR ± 5°C safety factor)

blocks.zh: CDMO 實戰建議：在撰寫驗證方案時，建議製作一張「參數理由表」(Parameter Justification Table)：左欄列出每個驗證參數、中欄列出選定的最差條件值、右欄提供理由（連結到 NOR/PAR 數據）。這樣在法規稽核時，可以一目了然地展示你的 QbD 思維。
blocks.en: CDMO practical advice: When writing the validation protocol, prepare a "Parameter Justification Table": the left column lists each validation parameter, the middle column lists the selected worst-case value, and the right column gives the rationale (linked to NOR/PAR data). This lets you demonstrate your QbD thinking at a glance during a regulatory inspection.

blocks.zh: NOR、PAR 和 Worst-Case Test Condition 三者之間的關係是什麼？請用一個具體的製程參數（如過濾壓差）來說明。
blocks.en: What is the relationship among the NOR, the PAR, and the worst-case test condition? Illustrate with a specific process parameter (such as filtration differential pressure).

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR26 強調安全係數必須「合理」？過度保守的安全係數可能帶來什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why does TR26 emphasize that the safety factor must be "reasonable"? What problems can an excessively conservative safety factor cause?

blocks.zh: 如果你的製程在開發過程中調整了 CPP（例如增加了最大過濾時間），這對已完成的濾膜驗證有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If the CPPs are changed during process development (for example, the maximum filtration time is increased), what is the impact on a filter validation that has already been completed?

blocks.zh: 6.4 Adsorption 6.4 吸附
blocks.en: 6.4 Adsorption

blocks.zh: Adsorption (吸附)：產品成分（如蛋白質、防腐劑、界面活性劑、API）黏附在濾膜表面的現象。這不是「過濾」行為——濾膜「吃掉」了你的產品。如果吸附量顯著，可能導致最終產品的有效成分濃度低於規格。
blocks.en: Adsorption: The phenomenon in which product components (such as proteins, preservatives, surfactants, or the API) adhere to the filter surface. This is not "filtration"; the filter is "eating" your product. If adsorption is significant, the concentration of the active ingredient in the final product may fall below specification.

blocks.zh: 關鍵區別——吸附 vs 截留：
blocks.en: Key distinction, adsorption vs. retention:

blocks.zh: 截留 (Retention)：濾膜的設計功能，擋住細菌 = 好事
blocks.en: Retention: The designed function of the filter; blocking bacteria = good

blocks.zh: 吸附 (Adsorption)：濾膜的副作用，黏住產品 = 壞事（需要評估是否在可接受範圍內）
blocks.en: Adsorption: A side effect of the filter; binding the product = bad (you must assess whether it is within acceptable limits)

blocks.zh: 想像你用咖啡濾紙過濾自製蛋白質飲品：
blocks.en: Imagine filtering a homemade protein drink through a coffee filter:

blocks.zh: 濾紙的功能是擋住咖啡渣（=細菌截留）
blocks.en: The filter paper's function is to block the coffee grounds (= bacterial retention)

blocks.zh: 但濾紙也可能吸附一些蛋白質和風味成分（=吸附效應）
blocks.en: But the paper may also adsorb some protein and flavor components (= adsorption effect)

blocks.zh: 第一杯過濾後的飲品可能比較淡（因為濾紙還沒飽和），後面幾杯才恢復正常濃度
blocks.en: The first cup filtered may taste weaker (because the paper is not yet saturated); only the later cups return to normal strength

blocks.zh: 同樣的道理，你需要確認濾膜吸附對產品品質的影響是否在可接受範圍內。
blocks.en: In the same way, you need to confirm that the effect of filter adsorption on product quality is within acceptable limits.

blocks.zh: Contact Time 有兩個方向的最差條件：Table 6.4-1🔍 列出了 Shortest 和 Longest 兩種，這是因為：
blocks.en: Contact time has worst cases in two directions: Table 6.4-1🔍 lists both Shortest and Longest, because:

blocks.zh: 最短接觸時間：濾膜尚未飽和，前段產品的吸附比例最高
blocks.en: Shortest contact time: The filter is not yet saturated, so the proportion of product adsorbed from the early portion is highest

blocks.zh: 最長接觸時間（靜態浸泡）：長時間浸泡可能使吸附達到新的平衡狀態
blocks.en: Longest contact time (static soak): Prolonged soaking may allow adsorption to reach a new equilibrium

blocks.zh: 兩種情境都需要評估。
blocks.en: Both scenarios need to be evaluated.

blocks.zh: 溫度與吸附的反向關係：大多數吸附過程在低溫時更顯著。因此如果你的產品需要冷藏過濾（如 2-8°C），吸附風險可能更高。
blocks.en: Temperature has an inverse relationship with adsorption: Most adsorption processes are more pronounced at low temperature. Therefore, if your product must be filtered under refrigeration (for example, 2-8°C), the adsorption risk may be higher.

blocks.zh: 低濃度更危險：看起來反直覺，但當產品濃度低時，濾膜表面積相對於產品量的比例更高，因此吸附的比例效應更明顯。
blocks.en: Lower concentration is more hazardous: Counterintuitively, when the product concentration is low, the ratio of filter surface area to product amount is higher, so the proportional effect of adsorption is more pronounced.

blocks.zh:
吸附率估算：

吸附率 (%) = (C_before - C_after) / C_before x 100%

其中：
  C_before = 過濾前產品濃度
  C_after  = 過濾後產品濃度

關鍵判斷：
  - 吸附率 < 規格容許範圍 → 可接受
  - 需收集多個時間點的樣品（例如：前段 10%、中段、後段）
  - 通常前段吸附最高，隨著濾膜飽和會逐漸下降
blocks.en:
Estimating the adsorption rate:

Adsorption rate (%) = (C_before - C_after) / C_before × 100%

Where:
  C_before = product concentration before filtration
  C_after  = product concentration after filtration

Key judgments:
  - Adsorption rate < allowable range in the specification → acceptable
  - Collect samples at multiple time points (for example: first 10%, middle, and final portions)
  - Adsorption is usually highest in the early portion and gradually decreases as the filter becomes saturated

blocks.zh: 高價值生物製劑情境：一支單抗藥品濃度為 10 mg/mL，如果濾膜吸附導致前段濾液濃度降低 5%（0.5 mg/mL），可能導致最終產品不符合含量規格（通常 95-105%）。解決方案包括：(1) 使用 pre-wetting（預濕）來減少吸附、(2) 丟棄前段濾液、(3) 選擇吸附性較低的濾膜材質。每一項都有成本和製程影響需要權衡。
blocks.en: High-value biologic scenario: For a monoclonal antibody drug product at 10 mg/mL, if filter adsorption lowers the concentration of the early filtrate by 5% (0.5 mg/mL), the final product may fail the assay specification (typically 95-105%). Solutions include: (1) using pre-wetting to reduce adsorption, (2) discarding the initial filtrate, and (3) selecting a filter membrane material with lower adsorption. Each option has cost and process implications that must be weighed.

blocks.zh: 為什麼低流速可能增加吸附？這與濾膜表面的接觸時間有什麼關係？
blocks.en: Why might a low flow rate increase adsorption? How does this relate to contact time with the filter surface?

blocks.zh: 如果你的產品含有界面活性劑 (Surfactant)，為什麼吸附測試特別重要？界面活性劑的吸附可能對產品功效產生什麼影響？
blocks.en: If your product contains a surfactant, why is adsorption testing especially important? What effect could surfactant adsorption have on product efficacy?

blocks.zh: Table 6.4-1🔍 中 pH 的最差條件是「Test Extremes」。請解釋為什麼 pH 極值可能影響吸附行為，以及它與濾膜表面電荷的關係。
blocks.en: In Table 6.4-1🔍, the worst case for pH is "Test Extremes". Explain why extreme pH values may affect adsorption behavior, and how this relates to the surface charge of the filter.

blocks.zh: 6.5 Extractables and Leachables 6.5 可葦出物與可溶出物
blocks.en: 6.5 Extractables and Leachables

blocks.zh: Extractables (可萃取物)：在人為加嚴條件下（高溫、強溶劑、長時間），從濾膜材料中被「萃取」出來的化學物質。代表「最大可能」釋出的物質總量。
blocks.en: Extractables: Chemical substances "extracted" from the filter materials under deliberately exaggerated conditions (high temperature, strong solvents, long duration). They represent the "maximum possible" total amount of released substances.

blocks.zh: Leachables (可溶出物)：在正常使用條件下，從濾膜材料「溶出」到產品中的化學物質。代表「實際會」進入產品的物質量。
blocks.en: Leachables: Chemical substances that "leach" from the filter materials into the product under normal conditions of use. They represent the amount of substances that "actually" enter the product.

blocks.zh: 兩者的關係：Extractables 通常是 Leachables 的超集合（superset）——leachables 通常是 extractables 的子集。但 TR26 特別提醒：「偶爾，產品成分與濾膜材料的交互作用可能產生 extractables 測試中未見的 leachables」。這意味著 extractables 測試不能100%預測所有 leachables。
blocks.en: Relationship between the two: Extractables are generally a superset of leachables; leachables are generally a subset of extractables. However, TR26 specifically cautions that "occasionally, interactions between product components and the filter materials may produce leachables not seen in extractables testing". This means extractables testing cannot predict all leachables with 100% certainty.

blocks.zh: Model Solvent Approach (模型溶劑法)：使用標準化溶劑（而非實際產品）來進行 extractables 測試。常用溶劑包括水、酸性溶液、鹼性溶液、有機溶劑等，用來模擬不同產品特性。
blocks.en: Model Solvent Approach: Extractables testing is performed with standardized solvents (rather than the actual product). Commonly used solvents include water, acidic solutions, basic solutions, and organic solvents, chosen to simulate different product characteristics.

blocks.zh: Extractables vs Leachables 就像泡茶：
blocks.en: Extractables vs. leachables is like brewing tea:

blocks.zh: Extractables = 把茶葉放在100°C的熱水中浸泡24小時——萃取出茶葉中「所有可能」釋出的物質（包括你正常泡茶時不會喝到的苦澀物質）
blocks.en: Extractables = soaking the tea leaves in 100°C water for 24 hours, extracting "everything that could possibly" be released from the leaves (including bitter substances you would never drink when brewing tea normally)

blocks.zh: Leachables = 按照正常方式泡茶（80°C、3分鐘）——你「實際」會喝到的東西
blocks.en: Leachables = brewing tea the normal way (80°C, 3 minutes), which gives what you would "actually" drink

blocks.zh: 先做 extractables 測試（了解最差情況），再評估是否需要做 leachables 測試（了解實際情況）。如果極端條件下萃取出的物質都在安全範圍內，正常使用條件下的風險就更低。
blocks.en: Perform the extractables study first (to understand the worst case), then assess whether a leachables study is needed (to understand the actual case). If even the substances extracted under extreme conditions are within safe limits, the risk under normal conditions of use is lower still.

blocks.zh: 滅菌方式影響 Extractables：Table 6.5-1🔍 特別列出了 Filter Sterilization 作為影響因素。高壓蒸氣滅菌 (Autoclave) 的溫度/次數越高，或 Gamma 照射劑量越高，可能會加速濾膜材料的降解，產生更多可萃取物。因此驗證時必須使用最差條件的滅菌處理。
blocks.en: The sterilization method affects extractables: Table 6.5-1🔍 specifically lists filter sterilization as an influencing factor. Higher autoclave temperature or number of cycles, or a higher gamma irradiation dose, may accelerate degradation of the filter materials and generate more extractables. Validation must therefore use worst-case sterilization treatment.

blocks.zh: 萃取方法的選擇：Static soak（靜態浸泡）和 Recirculation（循環流動）各有適用場景。靜態浸泡模擬長時間儲存情境，循環流動模擬實際過濾操作。兩種方法可能產生不同的萃取物分布。
blocks.en: Choice of extraction method: Static soak and recirculation each suit different scenarios. Static soak simulates long-term storage; recirculation simulates the actual filtration operation. The two methods may yield different extractables profiles.

blocks.zh: 毒理評估是必要步驟：光是知道有哪些可萃取物還不夠，還需要毒理學專家評估這些物質在預期劑量下對患者的安全風險。這通常涉及 AET (Analytical Evaluation Threshold) 的計算。
blocks.en: Toxicological assessment is a required step: Knowing which extractables are present is not enough; a toxicology expert must also assess the patient safety risk of these substances at the expected dose. This usually involves calculating the AET (Analytical Evaluation Threshold).

blocks.zh: Table 6.5-1🔍 的邏輯：每個參數的最差條件都是朝著「增加萃取可能性」的方向設定——更強的溶劑、更極端的 pH、更高的溫度、更長的時間、更嚴苛的滅菌。這符合 E&L 研究的基本原則：先在最差條件下評估，如果通過，則正常條件下更安全。
blocks.en: The logic of Table 6.5-1🔍: The worst case for each parameter is set in the direction that increases the likelihood of extraction: stronger solvent, more extreme pH, higher temperature, longer time, harsher sterilization. This follows the basic principle of E&L studies: evaluate under worst-case conditions first, and if they pass, normal conditions are safer still.

blocks.zh: Surrogate Solution 與 Bracketing Approach
blocks.en: Surrogate Solution and Bracketing Approach

blocks.zh: Surrogate Solution (替代溶液)：當實際藥品因下列原因無法使用時，可以用替代溶液：
blocks.en: Surrogate Solution: A surrogate solution may be used when the actual drug product cannot be used for the following reasons:

blocks.zh: 分析干擾：藥品成分干擾分析方法，無法檢測到微量 leachables
blocks.en: Analytical interference: Drug product components interfere with the analytical method, so trace leachables cannot be detected

blocks.zh: 成本過高：使用實際藥品進行 leachables 測試的成本不合理
blocks.en: Excessive cost: The cost of leachables testing with the actual drug product is unreasonable

blocks.zh: Bracketing Approach (包夾法)：使用多種溶液來「包夾」實際產品的特性（pH、離子強度、有機成分含量），確保測試涵蓋產品的所有相關特性。
blocks.en: Bracketing Approach: Multiple solutions are used to "bracket" the characteristics of the actual product (pH, ionic strength, organic content), ensuring the testing covers all relevant product characteristics.

blocks.zh: 文件化要求：無論使用 surrogate 或 bracketing，選擇理由和條件設定的合理性必須有書面記錄。
blocks.en: Documentation requirement: Whether a surrogate or bracketing approach is used, the rationale for the selection and for the chosen conditions must be documented.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的 E&L 策略：作為 CDMO，你可能服務多個使用相同濾膜型號的客戶。一個有效的策略是：
blocks.en: E&L strategy for a CDMO: As a CDMO, you may serve multiple clients using the same filter model. An effective strategy is:

blocks.zh: 與濾膜供應商取得標準化條件的 extractables 數據（通常免費或已包含在技術文件中）
blocks.en: Obtain extractables data under standardized conditions from the filter supplier (usually free or included in the technical documentation)

blocks.zh: 評估供應商數據是否涵蓋你的操作條件（溫度、pH、接觸時間、滅菌方式）
blocks.en: Assess whether the supplier data cover your operating conditions (temperature, pH, contact time, sterilization method)

blocks.zh: 如果供應商數據充分，可以避免重複 extractables 測試（參見 Section 4.6），節省成本和時間
blocks.en: If the supplier data are sufficient, repeat extractables testing can be avoided (see Section 4.6), saving cost and time

blocks.zh: 僅在特定產品的風險評估顯示需要時，才進行 leachables 測試
blocks.en: Perform leachables testing only when the risk assessment for a specific product shows it is needed

blocks.zh: 這種分層策略可以在確保安全的前提下，大幅優化驗證的時間和成本。
blocks.en: This tiered strategy can substantially optimize validation time and cost while still ensuring safety.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR26 指出「leachables 有時會出現 extractables 測試中未檢測到的物質」？這對 E&L 研究策略有什麼啟示？
blocks.en: Why does TR26 point out that "leachables sometimes include substances not detected in extractables testing"? What does this imply for E&L study strategy?

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下你會選擇 static soak 方法？在什麼情況下會選擇 recirculation 方法？各自模擬的是哪種使用情境？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances would you choose the static soak method? Under what circumstances would you choose recirculation? Which use scenario does each simulate?

blocks.zh: 你的客戶生產一支高價值的基因治療產品（每批價值 $500,000），leachables 測試需要使用實際藥品。你會建議使用 surrogate solution 嗎？如果是，你會如何設計替代方案並提供合理化理由？
blocks.en: Your client manufactures a high-value gene therapy product (each batch worth $500,000), and leachables testing would require the actual drug product. Would you recommend a surrogate solution? If so, how would you design the surrogate approach and provide a reasonable justification?
